content.title: USMNT Road to 2026 Ticket Presale | U.S. Soccer Official Website
content.text: U.S. Men's National Team Send Off Matches INSIDERS PRESALE ACCESSAtlanta: USMNT vs. BelgiumMar. 28 | U.S. Men’s National Team vs. Belgium | Atlanta, GAThe USMNT opens with a heavyweight punch as they take on No. 8 Belgium inside Mercedes-Benz Stadium. The Red Devils roll in with global superstars like Kevin De Bruyne and Thibaut Courtois, making this an opportunity for Pochettino’s squad.Atlanta: USMNT vs. PortugalMar. 31 | U.S. Men’s National Team vs. Portugal presented by Bank of America | Atlanta, GAThree days later, Atlanta gets another blockbuster as the USMNT meets No. 6 Portugal in a primetime showdown. Fresh off a UEFA Nations League title and led by icons like Cristiano Ronaldo, Portugal brings a style and swagger that demands the USMNT’s best.Charlotte: USMNT vs. TBCMay. 31 | Allstate Continental Clasico: U.S. Men’s National Team | Charlotte, NCAfter announcing the final World Cup roster, the USMNT heads to Charlotte for the Allstate Continental Clásico. Be there at Bank of America Stadium for a late-spring clash against a soon-to-be-announced global opponent and get your first look at the 26 players ready to take stage in 2026.Chicago: USMNT vs. GermanyJune. 6 | Coca-Cola Send Off Match: U.S. Men’s National Team vs. Germany | Chicago, ILThe finale lands in Chicago with a Coca-Cola Send Off Match: USMNT vs. four-time World Cup champion Germany at Soldier Field. With stars like Kai Havertz and Jamal Musiala, Germany brings world-class pedigree—making this the perfect final test before the World Cup. Don’t miss your last chance to see the squad before the journey begins.Platinum TicketsTicketmaster Platinum tickets are the most in-demand seats, limited quantity available now. These tickets are available now to anyone for purchase!VIP JacketsAs a VIP Insider, you get even earlier presale access, secure your seats before the crowd and take advantage of this exclusive benefit! Plus, as part of your membership, you’ll receive an official VIP Insider jacket, a complimentary benefit designed for our most dedicated fans. Gear up to stay warm & support your women’s national team this January!Other Ways To BuyVISA Presale: As the official payment technology sponsor of U.S. Soccer, Visa is offering cardholders an opportunity to purchase tickets in advance of the public on-sale date. Visa cardholders can purchase tickets from Thursday, December 4 at 4 p.m. ET through Friday, December 5 at 10 a.m. ET through ussoccer.com. As the preferred card of U.S. Soccer, Visa will be the only payment method accepted during the Visa presale. Terms and conditions apply.Public on sale: For the general public, access to tickets starts on Friday, December 5th at 10am EST
